subject.title: fix(sms): ack rate-limited Twilio callbacks instead of dropping them [AI]

question: Should authenticated SMS callbacks above the dispatch quota be accepted and permanently discarded, or must the plugin preserve processing or Twilio retry/fallback behavior?
rationale: Empty TwiML is a successful Twilio response while this branch skips dispatch, so the choice defines both the channel delivery contract and the public-webhook overload boundary rather than merely selecting an implementation detail.

options.title: Preserve delivery semantics
options.body: Queue or process validated callbacks, or retain a failure response so configured retry and fallback handling remain available.

options.title: Approve lossy acknowledgement
options.body: Explicitly define authenticated quota overflow as accepted-and-discarded and document and monitor that operational policy.

options.title: Pause for durable intake
options.body: Hold the response change until validated callbacks can be durably accepted and processed after the immediate quota window.

recommendation.title: Preserve delivery semantics
recommendation.body: Queue or process validated callbacks, or retain a failure response so configured retry and fallback handling remain available.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current SMS webhook implementation and have the strongest current-main history connection to its delivery and security contract.
